newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair, Lufthansa start maintenance coop.
newsitem.headline: Finnair, Lufthansa start maintenance coop.

text.p: Finnish airline Finnair said in a statement on Monday it had set up a long-term strategic maintenance cooperation with German Lufthansa, based on which it had won a nine-year deal worth 300 million markka.
"Finnair's technical unit and Lufthansa Technik have signed a long term strategic letter of intent on aircraft maintenance," Finnair said.
"On the basis of that, it has already been agreed that Finnair will make heavy maintenance on five MD-11F freight aircraft ordered by Lufthansa, and the bulk of equipment service," Finnair said.
"The value of the deal covering nine years for Finnair is at least 300 million markka in today's money," it said.
